description: Meeting update: validation, reschedule rules and invitation staging.
precondition: Meeting in an editable status; organizer actor.

cases.inputs: input: new title "Họp mới", same times.
cases.log: Saved: Meeting row with new title and UpdatedAt; no history row.
preconditions: Draft meeting owned by the actor.
cases.return: Success; title updated, status still Draft; Rescheduled false; MSG30.

preconditions: Meeting does not exist or is not owned by the actor.
cases.return: Failure NotFound (404); the input factory is not called.
Failure NotEditable; MSG33; the input is not read or validated.
Invalid; errors { title }; MSG31; nothing saved.

cases.inputs: input: same title, mode, sensitivity, description; start +1 day, end +1 day.
cases.log: Saved: Meeting; history row Reschedule (Published to Published) by the organizer; invitation emails staged with previous times; notification "Cuộc họp đã dời lịch" for every current invitee except the organizer.
preconditions: Published meeting; the planned start moves to a later time.
cases.return: Success with Rescheduled true; MSG138; status stays Published.

cases.exception: PersistenceException is caught inside the service.
cases.log: Error logged with meeting and actor ids; transaction rolled back.
cases.return: Failure SaveFailed; MSG36; the error is logged.
